spec.name: canon-gates-off-codex
spec.intent: Move canon's harness gates and the repository's projection scripts to the supported harnesses. census @ 8753f969 (local://what-ships-census.md): 73 lines. harness-parity.test.ts compares claude and omp and reads .cratylus/{claude,omp}. Remove the canon:project:codex script, drop it from `project`, and remove it from gates.yml's 'project every harness' step. event-vocabulary.test.ts drops the codex maps, and its unconfigured-harness refusal uses a non-harness name. hook-act-selector.test.ts keeps the claude selector law and drops the codex loss half. It either re-targets its convicting fixture to a supported harness or deletes it. runtime-shim.test.ts proves byte-identical shims across claude and omp. authored-source-is-text.test.ts re-targets its fixture file off packages/forge/src/adapters/codex/render.ts, because that file is deleted later. pack-smoke, architecture and command-veracity drop their codex mentions. Reword the codex history in .gitignore and cratylus.config.ts.
accept: `git grep -n -i codex -- <the 12 outputs>` prints nothing. At 8753f969 it prints 73.
`rm -rf .cratylus && pnpm project && ls .cratylus` prints exactly `claude omp`. At 8753f969 it prints claude codex omp.

`pnpm build && pnpm project && pnpm --filter @cratylus/canon exec vitest run test/event-vocabulary.test.ts test/hook-act-selector.test.ts test/harness-parity.test.ts test/runtime-shim.test.ts test/pack-smoke.test.ts test/architecture.test.ts test/command-veracity.test.ts test/authored-source-is-text.test.ts` is green, and `pnpm exec biome check` passes on the outputs.
